caption: The drawing depicts a single, elongated rectangular metallic object with rounded ends, predominantly gold in color with greenish and brownish patinas to suggest metallic sheen and age. The surface of the object features an ornate, raised decorative pattern; on the left half, there are three elongated leaf-like motifs and an arrangement of flowers and berries, followed by a central scroll and floral design with a few curving stems extending toward the right. The background behind the raised decorations consists of a diamond or crosshatch pattern covering the lower and right sections of the object. The edges and corners are bordered with simple raised lines, and slight shadowing is visible along the bottom edge, suggesting volume and thickness. The object rests on a plain, off-white background, with the name “Harry Jennings” written lightly beneath it in the lower right quadrant of the image.
title: Tie-back
